cases.mid: 画面表示・レイアウト (Screen display / layout)
cases.name: Initial Customer Update screen renders with header, captions and function-key legend
cases.precondition: F-STD. Operator signed on; transaction `ORUU` started from the main menu.
cases.steps:
1. Start transaction `ORUU` from the main menu
2. Observe the Customer Update screen on first display
cases.expected: The title `ORION CREDIT CARD MANAGEMENT SYSTEM` and the header (Tran `ORUU`, Pgm `OCCUSTU`, current date and time) are shown. The captions `Cust ID :`, `First   :`, `Last    :`, `Address :`, `City    :`, `Phone   :` and the bottom legend `ENTER=Process  PF3=Back  PF4=Clear` are displayed.

cases.mid: 初期値・デフォルト (Initial values / defaults)
cases.name: On open, input fields are empty, cursor sits at Cust ID and the prompt is shown
cases.precondition: F-STD. Fresh Customer Update screen on first entry.
cases.steps:
1. Start transaction `ORUU`
2. Check the input fields, cursor position and message line
cases.expected: All six input fields (Cust ID / First / Last / Address / City / Phone) are empty, the cursor rests in the Cust ID field, and the message line shows `Enter a customer id and press ENTER to load.`
cases.remark: 1000-SEND-INITIAL · LOW-VALUES to map · MOVE -1 TO CUSTIDL · WS-M-PROMPT

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Load a customer by id (step 1) shows its current values for editing
cases.steps:
1. Enter Cust ID = 000000001
2. Press ENTER
cases.data: Cust ID = 000000001 (JOHN Q SMITH on file)
cases.expected: The record for 000000001 is displayed for editing — First `JOHN`, Last `SMITH`, Address `123 MAIN STREET`, City `NEW YORK`, Phone `212-555-0101` — and the message line shows `Record loaded - change fields and ENTER to save.`

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Change one field and save (step 2) rewrites the customer record
cases.steps:
1. With 000000001 loaded, change Phone from `212-555-0101` to `212-555-7777`
2. Press ENTER (same id still keyed)
cases.expected: The customer record 000000001 is saved with Phone `212-555-7777` (First/Last/Address/City unchanged) and the message line shows `Customer updated successfully.` The amended values stay on screen and remain editable.

cases.name: Keying a different id after a load restarts at the load step
cases.steps:
1. With 000000001 loaded, change the Cust ID to 000000002
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: Instead of saving, the system loads customer 000000002 and shows its values — First `MARIA`, Last `GARCIA`, City `SAN FRANCISCO`, Phone `415-555-0102` — with `Record loaded - change fields and ENTER to save.`

cases.name: After a successful save the record stays loaded so further edits can be saved
cases.precondition: F-STD. Customer 000000003 loaded and just saved once.
cases.steps:
1. After the update-successful message for 000000003, change City from `CHICAGO` to `EVANSTON`
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The second change is saved (City `EVANSTON`) and `Customer updated successfully.` is shown again — the load flag stayed set so no reload was needed.
cases.remark: 6200 keeps flag L; second ENTER re-enters 2400-APPLY-UPDATE (idempotent re-edit)

cases.name: Saving changes to all five editable fields writes every one to the record
cases.steps:
1. With 000000004 loaded, change First=`MARIANNE`, Last=`CLARK`, Address=`900 BAYSHORE BLVD`, City=`TAMPA`, Phone=`813-555-0200`
2. Press ENTER
cases.data: Cust ID = 000000004; First `MARIANNE`; Last `CLARK`; Address `900 BAYSHORE BLVD`; City `TAMPA`; Phone `813-555-0200`
cases.expected: All five edited values are saved to record 000000004 — First `MARIANNE`, Last `CLARK`, Address `900 BAYSHORE BLVD`, City `TAMPA`, Phone `813-555-0200` — and `Customer updated successfully.` is shown.

cases.mid: データ整合性・冪等性 (Data integrity / idempotency)
cases.name: Fields not on the screen are preserved after an update
cases.precondition: F-STD. Customer 000000001 loaded (middle name `Q`, SSN 123456789, FICO 720, state NY, ZIP 10001, DOB 1985-06-15).
cases.steps:
1. With 000000001 loaded, change only Last to `SMITHERS`
2. Press ENTER
3. Reload 000000001 and inspect the record
cases.expected: Only the Last name changes to `SMITHERS`; the off-screen fields keep their prior values — middle name `Q`, SSN `123456789`, FICO `720`, state `NY`, ZIP `10001`, DOB `1985-06-15` are unchanged. `Customer updated successfully.` is shown.
cases.remark: 6100 overlays only the 5 editable fields; read-for-update record retains CU-MIDDLE-NAME/CU-SSN/CU-FICO-SCORE/CU-ADDR-STATE/CU-ADDR-ZIP/CU-DOB

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF3 returns to the main menu
cases.precondition: F-STD. On the Customer Update screen (fresh, or with a customer loaded).
cases.steps: 1. Press PF3
cases.expected: The transaction hands control to the main menu (OCMENU); the Customer Update screen is left without saving anything.

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF4 clears the entries and restarts the load step
cases.precondition: F-STD. Customer 000000002 loaded with edits typed in.
cases.steps: 1. With edits typed for 000000002, press PF4
cases.expected: The screen is redrawn empty with the cursor back at Cust ID, the load flag reset, and the prompt `Enter a customer id and press ENTER to load.` shown — the typed edits are discarded.

cases.name: Blank customer id is rejected on ENTER
cases.steps:
1. Leave the Cust ID field blank
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: No read occurs; the message line shows `Customer id is required.` and the cursor returns to the Cust ID field.

cases.name: Non-numeric customer id is rejected
cases.steps:
1. Enter Cust ID = `12345678X`
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: No read occurs; the message line shows `Customer id must be numeric.` and the cursor returns to the Cust ID field.

cases.name: Blank first name is rejected at save
cases.steps:
1. With 000000001 loaded, clear the First field
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The record is not rewritten; the message line shows `First name is required.` and the cursor returns to the First field.
cases.remark: 5000-EDIT-FIELDS CUFNAMI = SPACES → WS-M-FNAME-REQ · MOVE -1 TO CUFNAML

cases.name: Blank last name is rejected at save
cases.steps:
1. With 000000002 loaded, clear the Last field
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The record is not rewritten; the message line shows `Last name is required.` and the cursor returns to the Last field.
cases.remark: 5000-EDIT-FIELDS CULNAMI = SPACES → WS-M-LNAME-REQ · MOVE -1 TO CULNAML

cases.name: Blank address line 1 is rejected at save
cases.steps:
1. With 000000003 loaded, clear the Address field
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The record is not rewritten; the message line shows `Address line 1 is required.` and the cursor returns to the Address field.
cases.remark: 5000-EDIT-FIELDS CUADDRI = SPACES → WS-M-ADDR-REQ · MOVE -1 TO CUADDRL

cases.name: Blank city is rejected at save
cases.steps:
1. With 000000004 loaded, clear the City field
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The record is not rewritten; the message line shows `City is required.` and the cursor returns to the City field.
cases.remark: 5000-EDIT-FIELDS CUCITYI = SPACES → WS-M-CITY-REQ · MOVE -1 TO CUCITYL

cases.name: Blank primary phone is rejected at save
cases.steps:
1. With 000000005 loaded, clear the Phone field
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The record is not rewritten; the message line shows `Primary phone is required.` and the cursor returns to the Phone field.
cases.remark: 5000-EDIT-FIELDS CUPHONEI = SPACES → WS-M-PHONE-REQ · MOVE -1 TO CUPHONEL

cases.name: Validation stops at the first field in error
cases.steps:
1. With 000000001 loaded, clear BOTH the First and the Last fields
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: Only the first error is reported — the message line shows `First name is required.` (not the last-name message) and the cursor sits on the First field; the check stops at the first failure.
cases.remark: 5000-EDIT-FIELDS checks in order; WS-EDIT-GOOD gate short-circuits after the first failure → WS-M-FNAME-REQ

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: Loading an id that is not on file reports customer not found
cases.steps:
1. Enter Cust ID = 000000006
2. Press ENTER
cases.data: Cust ID = 000000006 (not on file; seed holds 000000001–000000005)
cases.expected: No record is shown; the message line displays `Customer not found - check the id and retry.` and the cursor returns to the Cust ID field.

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: Record deleted between load and save reports it must be reloaded
cases.precondition: F-STD. Customer 000000002 loaded; then another task deletes 000000002 from the customer file before the save.
cases.steps:
1. Load 000000002
2. Another task deletes record 000000002 from the customer file
3. Change Phone to `415-555-8888` and press ENTER
cases.expected: The re-read for update finds nothing; the message line shows `Record no longer on file - reload the id.` and the cursor returns to the Cust ID field; no rewrite occurs.

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: A customer-file read failure is reported
cases.precondition: F-STD, but the customer file is disabled / unavailable (an I/O fault is injected).
cases.steps:
1. Enter Cust ID = 000000001
2. Press ENTER while the customer file is unavailable
cases.data: Cust ID = 000000001; customer file returns an I/O error (neither normal nor not-found)
cases.expected: The load cannot complete; the message line shows `Error reading the customer file.` The same message also guards the save-time re-read.
cases.remark: 3000-READ-CUST / 6000-READ-FOR-UPDATE WHEN OTHER resp → WS-M-READ-ERROR (env fault, one representative for both READs)

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: A rewrite failure at save is reported
cases.precondition: F-STD. Customer 000000001 loaded; the customer file rejects the rewrite (an I/O fault is injected).
cases.steps:
1. Load 000000001, change Phone to `212-555-1212`
2. Press ENTER while the file rejects the rewrite
cases.data: Cust ID = 000000001; rewrite returns an I/O error
cases.expected: The change is not committed; the message line shows `Error rewriting the customer record.` and the cursor returns to the First field.

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: An unsupported key is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD. On the Customer Update screen.
cases.steps: 1. Press PF9 (an unsupported key)
cases.expected: A fresh screen is redrawn and the message line shows `Invalid key pressed. Please try again.`

cases.name: A single-digit customer id is zero-extended and loads the record
cases.steps:
1. Enter Cust ID = `5` (one digit, left-justified)
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The id is treated as 000000005; customer `DAVID D BROWN` (`654 PINE STREET`, `SEATTLE`) is loaded and redisplayed as `000000005`, with `Record loaded - change fields and ENTER to save.`
cases.remark: 7600-VALIDATE-NUM counts 1 digit · FUNCTION NUMVAL · CU-ID 9(09) zero-extend · CUSTIDO redisplay

cases.name: A full 9-digit id is accepted by the numeric edit then reported not on file
cases.steps:
1. Enter Cust ID = 999999999 (nine digits, the maximum width)
2. Press ENTER
cases.data: Cust ID = 999999999 (max 9-digit value; not on file)
cases.expected: The numeric edit accepts all nine digits (no format error); the read then reports `Customer not found - check the id and retry.`
cases.remark: CU-ID 9(09) max width; 7600-VALIDATE-NUM good → 2300 READ NOTFND → WS-M-CUST-NOTFND

cases.name: A 25-character first name (field maximum) is accepted and saved
cases.steps:
1. With 000000001 loaded, set First to a 25-character value `ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXY`
2. Press ENTER
cases.data: Cust ID = 000000001; First = `ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXY` (25 chars = field max)
cases.expected: The full 25 characters are accepted and saved; `Customer updated successfully.` is shown with no truncation.
